description: This is a Riso-only OOP feature; the entry points for Contract Info and Lesson History must not appear for non-Riso tenants.
preconditions: Logged in as Student to a non-Riso tenant's Learner App (e.g. Renseikai)
steps_actions:
1. "Open the User Profile menu"
2. "Open the app main menu"
steps_result:
1. "No "Contract Info" entry point is shown"
2. "No "Lesson History" entry point is shown"

title: [Riso] Contract Info – Student Own Data Only – Other Student's Contracts Not Accessible
description: A student must never be able to view another student's Contract Info or Lesson Allocated data.
preconditions:
Logged in as Student A to the Riso Learner App
Student B (a different student, no relationship to Student A) has active LAs and contracts
steps_result: 1. "Only Student A's own LA cards are shown; Student B's data is never displayed or reachable"

title: [Riso] Contract Info and Lesson History – Parent With Multiple Linked Children – Data Scoped to Selected Child (Pending Confirmation)
description: For a parent account linked to multiple children
preconditions: both pages must scope strictly to whichever child is currently selected (spec Clarification Question #9).
postconditions: Logged in as Parent to the Riso Learner App, linked to Child A and Child B
steps_result:
1. "Select Child A in the profile header and open Contract Info"
2. "Switch the profile header selector to Child B and reopen Contract Info"
steps_data:
1. "Only Child A's LA cards are shown"
2. "Only Child B's LA cards are shown; Child A's data is no longer visible"
milestone_id:
1. "selected_child=A; expected=Child A data only"
2. "selected_child=B; expected=Child B data only"

title: [Riso] Contract Info – Data Sync Staleness Banner – Displayed Until New Contract Reflected
description: The info banner acknowledges eventual-consistency lag between the Riso ERP contract push (LT-98533 API) and its display on the App.
preconditions:
Logged in as Student to the Riso Learner App
A new Riso Contract was just submitted via the API for this student's LA, not yet reflected in the App cache
steps_actions:
1. "Open Contract Info immediately after the API submission"
2. "Reopen Contract Info after the sync completes"
steps_result:
1. "The info banner is shown; Total Slot may not yet reflect the new contract"
2. "Total Slot now reflects the new contract"
steps_data:
1. "contract_submitted_at=T+0; app_view_at=T+0; expected=banner shown, data may lag"
2. "app_view_at=T+sync_complete; expected=data updated"

title: [Riso] Total Slot – Contract Created via API – Becomes Visible on Next Page Load
description: A Contract created via the LT-98533 API for an LA must be reflected in the App's Total Slot without requiring any App-side action.
preconditions:
Logged in as Student to the Riso Learner App
Student's LA currently has Total Slot = 0 (no contracts yet)
steps_actions:
1. "Submit a new Active Monthly-type Riso Contract via the API for this LA (start=2025-04, monthly slot=4, current selected month=Sep 2025)"
2. "Reopen the Contract Info page"
steps_result:
1. "Contract is created and linked to the LA"
2. "Total Slot now shows the newly submitted contract's contribution"
steps_data:
1. "contract_slot=4; contract_start=2025-04"
2. "selected_month=2025-09; expected=Total Slot reflects new contract (pending confirmation of exact formula, see Clarification Q1)"

title: [Riso] Lesson History – Draft Lesson – Never Displayed Regardless of Other Filters
description: A Draft-status lesson must never appear in Lesson History since Draft lessons are never synced to Mobile at the platform level.
preconditions:
Logged in as Student to the Riso Learner App
Student has a Draft-status lesson on 2025-09-20 that would otherwise match the selected month
steps_result: 1. "The Draft lesson on 2025-09-20 is NOT shown (never reaches Mobile)"

title: [Riso] Total Slot and Lesson Allocated – Cross-Surface Regression – Contract Update Reflected Consistently Across App
postconditions: End-to-end check that a single Contract update via the API is reflected consistently (or its known divergence documented) across the App
tags: the SF Monthly Lesson Assignment report (LT-98531)
severity:
Logged in as Student to the Riso Learner App and as HQ or CM Staff to the Salesforce org (same student's LA)
LA has one Active Monthly-type Riso Contract: start=2025-04, monthly slot=4
milestone:
1. "Update the Contract's monthly slot from 4 to 6 via the API"
2. "View Total Slot on the App for September 2025"
3. "View LA.Total_Session_Count on Salesforce"
suite_id:
1. "LA aggregation recalculates"
2. "App shows updated value per PRD's prorated formula (6x6=36)"
3. "SF shows the flat aggregated value per LT-98533, compare against step 2 and log any discrepancy as pending confirmation (Clarification Q1)"
suite_parent_id:
1. "new_monthly_slot=6"
2. "app_total_slot expected=36 (pending confirmation vs API aggregation)"
3. "sf_total_session_count = SUM(contract.total); compare vs app value"
